disorder.name: Major Depressive Disorder
disorder.dsm5_section: DSM-5-TR / Depressive Disorders / Major Depressive Disorder

strict.name: depressed_mood
strict.description: Persistent sad, empty, or irritable mood; dysphoric affect; depressive affect. DSM-5-TR Criterion A1 (and children/adolescents: irritable mood). Mouse anchors: forced swim test (Porsolt 1977) — immobility as behavioral despair proxy, tail suspension test, chronic unpredictable stress (CUS/CUMS) depressive-like profile, social defeat stress (Krishnan & Nestler 2008).

strict.name: anhedonia
strict.description: Diminished pleasure / reduced reward responsiveness to natural reinforcers; loss of interest in previously rewarding stimuli. Mouse anchors: sucrose preference test (Willner 1987), ICSS threshold elevation, female urine sniff test, progressive ratio break point.

strict.name: weight_appetite_change
strict.description: Bidirectional dysregulation of food intake and body weight — restriction with weight loss (AN, MDE A3 weight loss) OR binge/excessive intake with weight gain (BN/BED, MDE A3 weight gain). Within-individual cycling allowed. Mouse anchors: 2-bottle palatable food choice, intake/weight monitoring, activity-based anorexia (Routtenberg 1968), DIO weight gain, intermittent binge access models.

strict.name: sleep_disturbance
strict.description: Sleep architecture abnormality — disturbed sleep, insomnia, hypersomnia, REM fragmentation, decreased sleep need. Within-individual cycling allowed. Mouse anchors: polysomnography, sleep-deprivation paradigms, REM/NREM ratio, sleep onset latency.

strict.name: psychomotor_change
strict.description: Bidirectional motor activity disturbance — agitation OR retardation, depending on disorder state. Within-individual cycling allowed. Mouse anchors: open field locomotion, home-cage activity, forced-swim immobility, novelty-induced activity.

strict.name: fatigue
strict.description: Fatigue or loss of energy; decreased physical activity; lethargy. DSM-5-TR Criterion A6. Mechanistically linked to dopaminergic effort-evaluation circuits (Salamone et al. 2007) and vegetative cluster (Hasler 2004). Mouse anchors: home-cage wheel running reduction, grip strength, voluntary locomotion in chronic-stress models, operant effort tasks (progressive ratio for food).

strict.name: worthlessness_guilt
strict.description: Feelings of worthlessness or excessive/inappropriate guilt; negative self-schema; self-blame. DSM-5-TR Criterion A7. Beck cognitive triad — negative self-view component. Mouse anchors: stress-induced passive coping (contextual freezing in non-threat context), defeat-induced submissive posture, reduced social dominance post-defeat (Kim 2016 hierarchy shift).

strict.name: concentration_indecisiveness
strict.description: Reduced capacity to think clearly or concentrate, or trouble making decisions, on most days. DSM-5-TR Criterion A8. Snyder 2013 meta-analytic framework on executive dysfunction in depression. Mouse anchors: 5-CSRTT attentional performance (Robbins 2002), reversal learning deficits, T-maze delayed alternation, cognitive flexibility assays in chronic-stress models.

strict.name: suicidality
strict.description: Repeated thoughts about death, suicidal thoughts, or a suicide attempt. DSM-5-TR Criterion A9. Beck hopelessness triad — suicidal cognition component. Mouse anchors: passive coping in learned helplessness (LH) paradigm (Seligman 1972), escape-failure in shuttlebox after inescapable shock, deficit in escape learning. Note: direct suicidal ideation is non-modelable; the LH escape-failure proxy is used as a behavioral analog for motivational collapse.

stage1_hpo_curation.extraction_prompt_addendum: Three MDD Criterion A symptoms are intrinsically BIDIRECTIONAL per DSM-5-TR: A.3 weight_appetite_change (gain OR loss), A.4 sleep_disturbance (insomnia OR hypersomnia), A.5 psychomotor_change (agitation OR retardation). When the DSM text gives both directions in one criterion, emit TWO separate items (one per direction) and set polarity = 'bidirectional' on each. Do NOT extract from 'Note:' blocks unless the Note directly qualifies a specific Criterion item (the clause of item A.1 on irritable mood in children and adolescents is part of that item). The A.1 clause on irritable mood in children and adolescents must use temporality='developmental'.

stage2_rerank.developer_prompt_addendum: The 9 MDD Criterion A domains for context: depressed_mood, anhedonia, weight_appetite_change, sleep_disturbance, psychomotor_change, fatigue, worthlessness_guilt, concentration_indecisiveness, suicidality. BIDIRECTIONAL-DOMAIN RULE (MDD-specific): three MDD Criterion A symptoms are intrinsically bidirectional per DSM-5-TR (weight_appetite_change, sleep_disturbance, psychomotor_change). For HPO targets in these three domains, each target encodes ONE direction of the axis. When judging analog quality: same-direction mouse phenotype -> direct_analog or close_support; opposite-direction phenotype that maps to the SISTER directional target on the same axis -> NOT mismatch (the opposite-direction is the sister target's evidence). Use weak_support for loose support; use mismatch only if the mouse phenotype is genuinely incompatible with the MDD axis. strict_eligible=true only for high-quality organism-level analogs suitable for strict MDD-domain support.

score_floor.provenance: 0.57 was derived for ASD broad_v3 (2026-05-09 lab notebook): balanced-accuracy maximization of transparent_score against the LLM's own broad_eligible verdicts on the 180 LLM-judged pairs inside ambiguous-target rerank bundles. At θ=0.57, BA=0.736, precision=0.83, recall=0.70. Note: the 180 pairs were LLM-judged, not hand-curated — θ is a score-self-consistency threshold, not an externally-validated behavioral-analog cutoff.
score_floor.applies_to: Stage 2c fill pass. Pairs with transparent_score >= 0.57 that Stage 2b did not bundle (because their target was non-ambiguous or they sat below top-N) are submitted to the LLM for a second-pass eligibility judgment with the identical prompt and schema. Does NOT filter Stage 2b LLM-strict-eligible pairs (those bypass the floor).
score_floor.per_disorder_tuning_policy: DISALLOWED. Per-disorder θ tuning would add 20 DOF that reviewers see as fishing (Mode C), and the per-disorder calibration set would be each disorder's LLM verdicts — circular (Mode D, since we are gating Stage 2c LLM calls against Stage 2b LLM labels). If a future contributor needs per-disorder floor behavior, switch from a tuned VALUE to a uniform RULE (e.g., 80th-percentile of pair scores per disorder), so the same logic applies automatically across all disorders without per-disorder choices.

sensitivity_sweep_plan.outputs: rerun Stage 2c -> 3 -> 4 -> 5 once per floor; report AUROC across A2 (headline) and A1 (psychiatric pool); flag if any headline AUROC moves > 0.02 across the range.
sensitivity_sweep_plan.rationale: Pre-register the sweep before observing T0 AUROC so the robustness claim is blinded to outcome, not post-hoc.

stage3_aggregation.polarity_deferral_note: Three of 9 MDD Criterion A domains are intrinsically bidirectional, so ASD-style direction-aligned polarity weights are inappropriate. v1 uses polarity-off only. v2 may add an MDD-specific polarity schema with bidirectional-aware weight maps.

paradigms.include: \bbehavioral despair\b|\banhedonia\b|abnormal sucrose solution preference|\babnormal coping response\b|\bincreased coping response\b|\bdecreased coping response\b|depression[- ]related behavior|decreased reward seeking|reduced motivation
paradigms.exclude: long[- ]term depression|synaptic depression|depressor anguli oris|nasal bridge|cortical spreading depression
paradigms.citation: Cryan & Holmes 2005 Nat Rev Drug Discov; Treadway & Zald 2011 Neurosci Biobehav Rev

paradigms.name: MDD_sleep_disturbance
paradigms.include: abnormal sleep pattern|abnormal frequency of paradoxical sleep|abnormal sleep[- ]wake cycle|\binsomnia\b|\bhypersomnia\b|decreased REM (latency|sleep)|abnormal circadian rhythm
paradigms.citation: Hasler et al. 2004 Neuropsychopharmacology Tables 2-3 (vegetative cluster)

paradigms.name: MDD_appetite_weight_change
paradigms.low_confidence_caveat: hyperphagia/hypophagia are often metabolic rather than psychiatric in mouse annotation; require gene-evidence cross-validation
paradigms.disgenet_rationale: MGI MP ontology has no behavioral-domain appetite terms; rely on gene-disease associations in DisGeNET for MDD-with-appetite-axis or eating-disorder genes.

paradigms.name: MDD_psychomotor_change
paradigms.low_confidence_caveat: locomotor terms are noisy; require multiple hits or co-occurring sleep/anhedonia paradigm
paradigms.citation: Sobin & Sackeim 1997 Am J Psychiatry psychomotor in MDD

paradigms.name: MDD_concentration_cognitive
paradigms.include: impaired (working memory|attention|concentration)|abnormal (working memory|attention)|impaired cognitive flexibility|impaired reversal learning|executive (dys)?function deficit
paradigms.citation: Snyder 2013 Psychol Bull cognitive deficits in MDD

paradigms.name: MDD_chronic_stress_social_defeat
paradigms.include: social avoidance|social defeat|susceptibility to.*stress|reduced social investigation.*stress|abnormal response to chronic stress
paradigms.citation: Krishnan & Nestler 2008 Nature; Berton & Nestler 2006 Nat Rev Neurosci
paradigms.disgenet_rationale: MGI MP ontology has no chronic-stress/social-defeat terms; rely on gene-disease associations in DisGeNET for MDD or stress-related disorder genes.

rescue.tier1_exclusion_disabled_reason: ASD Tier-1 strict-validity MP terms are NOT excluded from MDD rescue scoring. Per 2026-05-22 amendment: the Tier-1 set contains transdiagnostic phenotypes (e.g., MP:0001361 social withdrawal, MP:0014115 cognitive inflexibility, MP:0001488 increased startle reflex) that are legitimately MDD-relevant per DSM-5-TR. The real anti-circularity guard is the dual-evidence Tier-1 rescue criterion (phenotype + DisGeNET gene_only) downstream, which requires independent human-genetic evidence not derived from mouse phenotypes. See lab notebook 2026-05-22 amendment + REFACTOR_LOG.md for full rationale.
